question: Single-engineer API hosting decision. Priorities: predictable egress/support and boring reliability for a single-engineer API. Candidates: Glacierpath, NimbusForge, Zephyr Host, Stackharbor, Ironpetal, Redwood Compute, Quietbarn Cloud, Solstice Compute, Copperline Cloud, Marble Rack. web_snippets.excerpt: NimbusForge is hyped on social; cold-start latency complaints keep recurring.
Stackharbor support closed a networking ticket overnight without tier theater.
Status history for Solstice Compute looks fine until a region blip; postmortems are thin.
Solstice Compute docs are friendly, but egress invoices surprised two indie teams last quarter.

notes: Contested evidence: two competitors look stronger on stated priorities; principal only in mixed tradeoff notes. No answer-key ranking.
